name: x-agent
description: Fifteen Claude skills and two agents that run an X account: posts off 21 hook formulas with a scored hook, a character counter that counts the way X does, threads cut to fit, replies, a profile score, the weekly plan read against X's own published ranking weights and exported to your calendar, DMs, an audit of your analytics export, a humanizer, a virality engine, a voice profiler measured from your own posts, a reply ledger, crisis handling, and a one-command pre-flight.
